summary.content:
Today's selection covers 77 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 51 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.1 and says it’s up to 45 percent cheaper for agentic work
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Ransomware Gang Claims Nutex Health Data Breach
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 49 articles published in the last 24 hours
